concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-internal-fund-transfers-return-transfers]] — 2020-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Platforms Transfers API guide for returning an original internal push transfer by ID and equal amount, with conditional cross-holder capabilities and webhook outcome tracking.
warnings: Return modifies the original internal push transfer; the return request ID differs from the original incoming transfer ID, and amount currency/value must match the original.
Support enablement, TransferService initiate role and conditional cross-holder sendToBalanceAccount/receiveFromBalanceAccount capabilities gate the route.

Authorised is not booked return; Declined can indicate a wrong original transfer ID but is not a complete failure taxonomy. Track actual return/failure webhooks and two-sided booking before claiming funds movement.
